links.outcome: Transparency of reasoning (explicit reasoning steps) and ethical reasoning score
links.effect: 4.2 vs 1.8 explicit reasoning steps (p < 0.001); mean ethics score 78.3 ± 9.1; 13.0% performance gain
links.quote: The study highlighted critical gaps in ethical decision-making transparency, with meta-cognitive approaches providing 4.2 explicit reasoning steps compared to 1.8 in zero-shot methods (p < 0.001).
